description: This file defines the FeatureDefinition interface in the Eclipse Ditto project, representing a collection of unique, fully qualified DefinitionIdentifiers. It provides methods to create FeatureDefinitions from identifiers or JSON, and to access their properties.

classes.name: FeatureDefinition
classes.description: An interface representing an immutable collection of unique, fully qualified DefinitionIdentifiers, with methods for creation from identifiers or JSON and for accessing its first identifier and size.

methods.name: fromIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a FeatureDefinition from an initial identifier and optional further identifiers, ensuring all are valid and non-null.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a FeatureDefinition from a JSON string representing a JSON array.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a FeatureDefinition from a JsonArray object.

methods.name: getFirstIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the first DefinitionIdentifier in the FeatureDefinition.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of DefinitionIdentifiers in the FeatureDefinition, guaranteed to be at least one.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a Stream of DefinitionIdentifiers contained in the FeatureDefinition.
